shots.name: v2-collide
shots.edit: Keep both people's faces, identities and hairstyles exactly as in the reference images: the girl from image 1 (long straight black hair with see-through bangs) and the boy from image 2. Both wear dark navy school blazers with white piping trim and a gold school crest, white shirts; she has a red ribbon tie, he has a loose navy tie. Medium-wide two-shot in a long school hallway with windows: she walks toward camera looking down at an open silver flip phone, the tall boy walks fast from the other side, their shoulders are about to collide. Photorealistic cinematic still from a 2006 Korean high school drama, winter, soft window daylight, shallow depth of field, film grain, natural skin texture, realistic background students, vertical 9:16 frame.
shots.motion: the boy bumps hard into the girl's shoulder, the silver flip phone flies out of her hand and falls to the floor, she stumbles and gasps, he keeps walking two steps then stops and turns his head back, handheld camera
